verdict.rationale: Sill is a Mac-to-iPhone/iPad screen-streaming and remote-control tool. It holds no user dataset to analyze: there is no account and no server. Asking for AI-generated insights from the user's data is therefore a category error for this kind of product, and nothing in the evidence shows any AI capability that would make the axis apply.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
